verses.t: May the hands of Abu Lahab be ruined, and ruined is he
verses.pickthall: The power of Abu Lahab will perish, and he will perish
verses.yusufAli: Perish the hands of the Father of Flame! Perish he
verses.rodwell: LET the hands of ABU LAHAB perish,and let himself perish
verses.sale: The hands of Abu Laheb shall perish, and he shall perish

verses.t: His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained
verses.pickthall: His wealth and gains will not exempt him
verses.yusufAli: No profit to him from all his wealth, and all his gains
verses.rodwell: His wealth and his gains shall avail him not
verses.sale: His riches shall not profit him, neither that which he hath gained

verses.t: He will [enter to] burn in a Fire of [blazing] flame
verses.pickthall: He will be plunged in flaming Fire
verses.yusufAli: Burnt soon will he be in a Fire of Blazing Flame
verses.rodwell: Burned shall he be at the fiery flame
verses.sale: He shall go down to be burned into flaming fire

verses.t: And his wife [as well] - the carrier of firewood
verses.yusufAli: His wife shall carry the (crackling) wood - As fuel
verses.rodwell: And his wife laden with fire wood
verses.sale: and his wife also, bearing wood

verses.t: Around her neck is a rope of [twisted] fiber
verses.pickthall: Will have upon her neck a halter of palm-fibre
verses.yusufAli: A twisted rope of palm-leaf fibre round her (own) neck
verses.rodwell: On her neck a rope of palm fibre
verses.sale: having on her neck a cord of twisted fibres of a palm-tree
